Backend: backend/app/classrooms.py (create classroom, add students), moderation_hold.py (held items, decision allow, replace or stop, withdraw), review.py (POST /jobs/{id}/review: approved, rejected, pending), review_notes.py (notes,

Frontend: frontend/app/classroom/page.tsx, [classroomId]/add, [classroomId]/books (held queue and review dialog), [classroomId]/settings (review themes, notes for students); frontend/components/NeedsHelpQueue.tsx, BookReviewDialog.tsx.
Docs: docs/specs/USER_FLOW.md section 3; docs/specs/magic-pencil.md; docs/specs/export-pdf.md. Where code and docs differ, the diagram follows the code (the PDF download is a student action).
